description: The plot illustrates the Max Activation Value across different layers for various components, including attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, and ffn_residual. The x-axis, labeled 'Layer', has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 20 with a tick label interval of 5. The y-axis, labeled 'Max Activation Value', also has a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 1600 with a tick label interval of 200. The plot features four lines: attn_output (blue, dashed), starting at approximately 100 at layer 0 and ending at around 500 at layer 20 with a steady increase; attn_residual (orange, dotted), beginning at roughly 100 at layer 0, peaking at about 1600 at layer 3, and then dropping to around 200 at layer 5 before rising again to approximately 1200 at layer 18; ffn_output (green, dash-dotted), starting at around 100 at layer 0, reaching a peak of about 1500 at layer 3, and then declining to roughly 200 at layer 5 before increasing to approximately 600 at layer 20; and ffn_residual (red, solid), beginning at around 100 at layer 0, peaking at about 1700 at layer 3, and then dropping to around 200 at layer 4 before rising to approximately 1700 between layers 6 and 16, and then decreasing to around 200 at layer 19.
